I need to make a decision for the current Monopoly turn.

I have $392 and four properties but no monopolies. p1 has a full pink monopoly and can build. p2 has only the Reading Railroad. p3 owns the Electric Company and just paid me $22.

p1's pink monopoly is the main threat. I have no monopolies to build on. Mortgaging would reduce my rent income.

I'm evaluating trade options to complete property sets. Boardwalk, Atlantic, and Marvin Gardens are unowned, so I cannot acquire them. Pacific and NC are also unowned. p1's pink monopoly could be a target for a deal.

No other player owns the properties needed to complete a set. Trading would not yield a monopoly right now. I should avoid giving away Park Place, Ventnor, or Pennsylvania Avenue cheaply. p1's pink monopoly could become dangerous if they build houses. I will stay liquid with my $392.

Mortgaging would reduce my income and I just bought Park Place. The best action is to end the turn. No trade can complete a set. p1 will not sell their pink monopoly cheaply.
